Part B · 新题型七选五（41–45）

【题目】关于网络计算机：下载（被动消费）vs 上传（主动创造）。从A-G中选5段填入空白，两个干扰项。

文章脉络：飞机/笔记本电脑/手机是天才们的发明→网络计算机是21世纪文化机器→但要警惕：它引发了下载与上传之间的秘密战争→所有动物都下载，只有人类会上传（创造物质和精神财富）→但大多数人仍卡在下载模式→电视是单向下载的，而网络计算机第一次提供了逆流而上、鼓励有意义上传的机会。

Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G
A
Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human. Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
当然，恰恰是这些多余之物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了何以为人。下载并消费文化需要很高的技巧，但止步于下载、不再超越，就等于剥夺了人性中一种决定性的构成要素。
B
Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
诸如 tumblr.com 这类应用，能让用户以创造性方式组合图片、文字与其他媒介并分享出去，有潜力通过逗乐、娱乐和启发他人来增加用户黏性。
C
Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
他们不仅开发出了这样一种设备，而且到千禧年之际，还成功将其嵌入一个每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统之中。
D
This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading - between passive consumption and active creation - whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.
这是因为联网计算机在"下载"与"上传"之间——亦即被动消费与主动创造之间——点燃了一场隐秘的战争，其结果将以我们才刚开始想象的方式塑造我们的共同未来。
E
The challenge the computer mounts to television thus bears little similarity to one format being replaced by another in the manner of record players being replaced by CD players.
因此，计算机对电视构成的挑战，与"唱片机被CD机取代"那种一种格式替代另一种格式的情形，几乎毫无相似之处。
F
One reason for the persistence of this pyramid of production is that for the past half-century, much of the world's media culture has been defined by a single medium - television - and television is defined by downloading.
这种生产金字塔之所以长久存在，原因之一在于过去半个世纪里，世界大部分媒介文化都由单一媒介——电视——所定义，而电视的本质就是下载。
G
The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow, to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
联网计算机提供了50年来首个扭转这一流向的机会，它鼓励审慎的下载，而更重要的是，鼓励有意义的"上传"。
41
句子还原题
答案 C
匹配依据[C] 他们不仅在20世纪发明了这种设备，而且在千年之交还把它嵌入了一个每天被数十亿人访问的全球系统。→ 上文讲20世纪天才们创造了各种机器（打字机、印刷机、收音机等），下文讲网络计算机。C承上启下，"this device"指代前文发明。
42
句子还原题
答案 D
匹配依据[D] 这是因为网络计算机引发了一场下载与上传之间——被动消费与主动创造之间——的秘密战争，其结果将以我们才开始想象的方式塑造集体未来。→ 下文紧接着"I call it a secret war for two reasons"，D首次提出"secret war"，完美承接。
43
句子还原题
答案 A
匹配依据[A] 当然，正是这些多余的东西定义了人类文化，最终定义了何以为人。下载和消费文化需要高超技能，但不能超越下载就等于剥夺了人之为人的根本构成。→ 上文刚说完人类独特之处在于用工具创造superfluous material goods和superfluous experiences，A紧承"superfluous"话题。
44
句子还原题
答案 F
匹配依据[F] 这种生产金字塔持续存在的一个原因是，在过去半个世纪里，世界大部分媒体文化被单一媒体——电视——所定义，而电视的定义就是下载。→ 上文描述了金字塔式生产（少数上传、稍多评论、绝大多数只消费），F解释其原因；下一段开头就讲Television is a one-way tap。
45
句子还原题
答案 G
匹配依据[G] 网络计算机提供了50年来第一次逆流而上的机会，鼓励有思考的下载，更重要的是，鼓励有意义的上传。→ 上文讲电视是单向流入家庭的龙头，最难的任务是关掉它。G讲计算机提供了反向流的机会，与电视形成对比。
干扰项[B] 像Tumblr这样的应用可让用户创造性组合图片文字再分享，有增加"黏性"的潜力；[E] 计算机挑战不像唱机被CD替代那样一种格式被另一种替代。两项均不贴合上下文逻辑。
Part C · 英译汉逐句翻译（46–50）
46
翻译
In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything—a single generative equation for all we see.
在物理学中，有一种方法将这种对统一性的渴求推向极致，寻求一种万有理论——一个能阐释我们所见一切的生成性公式。
采分点① impulse 冲动/渴求；② unification 统一；③ take...to its extreme 推向极致；④ a theory of everything 万有理论。
47
翻译
Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings.
这里，达尔文学说似乎提供了正当理由：如果全人类有共同的起源，那么似乎有理由认为，文化多样性也可以追溯到更为狭窄的开端。
采分点① justification 正当理由；② trace to 追溯到；③ constrained beginnings 受局限的开端。
48
翻译
To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
把独特之物从共享之物中筛选出来，或许能让我们理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，以及从进化或认知角度看是什么在引导它。
采分点① filter out 筛选；② arise 产生；③ in...terms 从……角度；④ cognitive 认知的。
49
翻译
The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints.
第二个由约书亚·格林伯格提出，它对普遍性采取了更为实证的研究方法，识别出许多语言共有的特征（尤其是词序方面），这些特征被认为代表了由认知局限所导致的偏向。
采分点① empirical 实证的；② universality 普遍性；③ trait 特征；④ cognitive constraints 认知局限。
50
翻译
Chomsky's grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent of the family tree or the pathway tracked through it, whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong co-dependencies between particular types of word-order relations.
乔姆斯基的语法应该显示出独立于语言谱系或沿其追溯路径的语言变化模式，而格林伯格式的普遍性则预测特定类型的词序关系之间存在强烈的相互依存。
采分点① be independent of 独立于；② family tree 语言谱系；③ whereas 而（对比）；④ co-dependency 相互依存。
Section III · Writing 写作
Part A 小作文（10分）— 欢迎邮件

原题指令 Directions

Suppose you are the chairman of the Student Union. Write an email to a group of international students who are about to study at your university. In the email, welcome them and give them some advice on campus life. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address.

【译文】假设你是学生会主席。给即将来你校就读的一群留学生写一封电子邮件，欢迎他们并就校园生活提一些建议。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。不要写地址。

题目

一些国际学生即将来到你的大学。以学生会名义给他们写一封电子邮件：1）表示欢迎，2）就校园生活给他们提一些建议。约100词，落款Li Ming，不写地址。

审题

① 格式：邮件；② 语气：热情友好；③ 内容：欢迎+2-3条具体建议（选课、交通、社交/生活适应）。

参考范文

Dear Friends,

On behalf of the Students' Union, I would like to extend our warmest welcome to you. We are genuinely thrilled to have you join our campus community.

To help you settle in smoothly, I would like to offer a few practical tips. First, make good use of the course-selection system and consult your academic advisor before finalizing your timetable. Second, the campus subway station is the most convenient way to explore the city, so do get a transportation card. Finally, do not hesitate to join student clubs, where you will make friends and experience Chinese culture firsthand.

We hope you enjoy your time here. Looking forward to meeting you!

Yours sincerely, Li Ming

【译文】

亲爱的朋友们：

我谨代表学生会，向你们致以最热烈的欢迎。我们由衷地高兴你们能加入我们的校园大家庭。

为帮助你们顺利安顿，我想提供几点实用建议。首先，充分利用选课系统，并在确定课表前咨询学业导师。其次，校园地铁站是游览城市最便捷的方式，记得办一张交通卡。最后，不妨加入学生社团，在那里你能结交朋友、亲身体验中国文化。

愿你们在此度过愉快时光。期待与你们相见！

谨上，李明

Part B 大作文（20分）— 乐观与悲观（面对同一只打翻的瓶子）

原题指令 Directions

Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The drawing shows two people facing a bottle that has fallen over and spilled some liquid. One frowns and cries, "It's all over!" while the other says optimistically, "Luckily there is still some left." Faced with the same situation, the two hold completely different attitudes.

【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 图中有两个人面对一只打翻在地、洒出些液体的瓶子。一人愁眉苦脸地喊“全完了！”，另一人却乐观地说“幸好还剩点儿”。面对同一种境况，两人态度截然不同。

图画描述

图中有两个人面对一只打翻在地、洒了一些液体的瓶子。一个人愁眉苦脸地喊道："全完了！"另一个人却乐观地说："幸好还剩点儿。"面对同一种境况，两人态度截然不同。

审题框架

三段式：①描述图画（打翻的瓶子+两种反应）；②阐释寓意（不同人面对困境有乐观和悲观两种态度，乐观更可取）；③评论（应保持积极心态）。160-200词。

参考范文

The cartoon vividly depicts two men reacting in opposite ways to the same spilled bottle. One buries his face in despair, crying, "It's all ruined!" while the other, relieved, exclaims, "Fortunately, there is still some left!" The contrast could not be sharper.

The drawing conveys a thought-provoking message: our attitude often matters more than the situation itself. Confronted with setbacks, pessimists fixate on what has been lost and sink into frustration, whereas optimists notice what remains and seek a way out. History abounds with examples showing that optimism is the very engine of perseverance, innovation and eventual success. Even a single spilled drop, seen through optimistic eyes, can still be salvaged.

From my perspective, we should all learn from the optimistic man. Life is bound to serve us spilled bottles now and then. Only by choosing to see the glass as half full can we keep up our morale, seize the remaining opportunities and march toward a brighter future.

【译文】

漫画生动地描绘了两人在面对同一只打翻的瓶子时截然不同的反应。一人绝望地埋下脸，喊道"全完了！"；另一人却如释重负地感叹："幸好还剩点儿！"对比之强烈，一目了然。

这幅画传达了发人深省的道理：态度往往比处境本身更重要。面对挫折，悲观者纠结于已失之物、陷入沮丧；而乐观者关注尚存之物、寻找出路。历史不乏其例：乐观正是坚持、创新与最终成功的引擎。即便是一滴洒出的水，用乐观的眼光看，也仍可挽回。

在我看来，我们都应向那位乐观者学习。人生难免时不时被递上一只打翻的瓶子。唯有选择"半满"的视角，我们才能保持斗志、抓住残存的机会，迈向更光明的未来。

Section I   Use of English · 完形填空逐句精读

People are, on the whole, poor at considering background information when making individual decisions. At first glance this might seem like a strength that 1 the ability to make judgments which are unbiased by 2 factors. But Dr Uri Simonsohn speculated that an inability to consider the big 3 was leading decision-makers to be biased by the daily samples of information they were working with. 4, he theorised that a judge 5 of appearing too soft 6 crime might be more likely to send someone to prison 7 he had already sentenced five or six other defendants only to forced community service on that day.

总的来说，人们在做个人决策时并不擅长考虑背景信息。乍一看，这似乎像是一种优势，它赋予了人们不受外部因素影响而做出公正判断的能力。但尤里·西蒙松博士推测，不考虑大局会导致决策者被日常接触的信息样本所误导。例如，他推断说，一个害怕对犯罪显得过于心慈手软的法官，如果当天已经连续判处五六名被告仅为强制性社区服务，那么他就更有可能把下一个人送进监狱。

To 8 this idea, he turned to the university-admissions process. In theory, the 9 of an applicant should not depend on the few others 10 randomly for interview during the same day, but Dr Simonsohn suspected the truth was 11.

为了检验这一想法，他转向了大学招生录取过程。从理论上讲，一个申请者的成功与否不应取决于同一天随机抽选出来一起面试的其他几位申请者，但西蒙松博士怀疑事实并非如此。

He studied the results of 9,323 MBA interviews 12 by 31 admissions officers. The interviewers had 13 applicants on a scale of one to five. This scale 14 numerous factors into consideration. The scores were 15 used in conjunction with an applicant's score on the Graduate Management Admission Test, or GMAT, a standardised exam which is 16 out of 800 points, to make a decision on whether to accept him or her.

他研究了由31名招生官员主持的9323场MBA面试结果。面试官按1到5分的等级给申请者打分。这个等级把众多因素纳入考量。然后，这些分数与申请者在GMAT（管理类研究生入学考试，一门满分为800分的标准化考试）上的分数结合起来，以决定是否录取该申请者。

Dr Simonsohn found if the score of the previous candidate in a daily series of interviewees was 0.75 points or more higher than that of the one 17 that, then the score for the next applicant would 18 by an average of 0.075 points. This might sound small, but to 19 the effects of such a decrease a candidate would need 30 more GMAT points than would otherwise have been 20.

西蒙松博士发现，在一天连续面试的申请者中，如果前一位候选人的分数比再前一位高0.75分或更多，那么下一位申请者的分数平均会下降0.075分。这听起来也许不多，但要抵消这种下降的影响，申请者需要在GMAT考试中多考出原本必要分数之外的30分。

Reading Part A · Text 1 逐句精读

In the 2006 film version of The Devil Wears Prada, Miranda Priestly, played by Meryl Streep, scolds her unattractive assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her. Priestly explains how the deep blue color of the assistant's sweater descended over the years from fashion shows to department stores and to the bargain bin in which the poor girl doubtless found her garment.

在2006年电影版《穿普拉达的女王》中，梅丽尔·斯特里普饰演的米兰达·普里斯特利斥责她那毫不起眼的助手，因为后者竟然认为高级时装与自己无关。普里斯特利解释说，助手毛衣的那种深蓝色是如何年复一年地从时装秀一路降级到百货商店，最后沦落到那个可怜女孩淘货的折价卖场的。

This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion." In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely. Quicker turnarounds mean less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit. These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable—meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that—and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks. By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.

这种关于时装业的自上而下的观念早已过时，也与伊丽莎白·克莱因耗时三年写成的《过度穿着》一书中所描绘的那个狂热世界格格不入——那本书是对"快时尚"的控诉。在过去十年左右，技术进步使得Zara、H&M、优衣库等大众市场品牌能更快地响应潮流、更精准地预测需求。更快的周转意味着库存浪费更少、新品发布更频繁、利润更高。这些品牌鼓励有时尚意识的消费者把衣服看成一次性的——虽然它们并不明说——只穿一两水就扔，每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。克莱因认为，这些品牌以极低的价格提供时髦商品，劫持了时尚周期，动摇了这个长期以来习惯于按季节节奏运转的行业。

The victims of this revolution, of course, are not limited to designers. For H&M to offer a $5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.

当然，这场革命的受害者不仅限于设计师。H&M要想在其全球2300多家门店都提供一条5.95美元的针织迷你裙，就必须依赖低工资的海外劳动力，大量订购以致过度消耗自然资源，并使用大量有害化学物质。

Overdressed is the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan's The Omnivore's Dilemma. "Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful," Cline argues. Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year—about 64 items per person—and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.

《过度穿着》是时尚界对迈克尔·波伦《杂食者的困境》这类消费者行动主义畅销书的回应。"批量生产的服装就像快餐，填饱了饥渴和需求，却不耐用又浪费，"克莱因说。她发现，美国人一年大约购买200亿件衣服——人均约64件——无论他们扔掉多少，这种过度消费都导致了浪费。

Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes—and beautifully. But as Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can't be knocked off.

在《过度穿着》结尾，克莱因介绍了她心目中的理想榜样——一位布鲁克林女性萨拉·凯特·博蒙特，她从2008年起就自己做所有衣服，而且做得很漂亮。但正如克莱因首先指出的那样，博蒙特花了几十年才精进手艺；她的榜样无法被简单复制。

Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment—including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line—Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer. She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy. Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.

尽管几家快时尚公司已努力控制其对劳工和环境的影响——包括H&M推出绿色" Conscious Collection"系列——但克莱因认为，持久的改变只能由消费者来促成。她展现了许多可持续发展倡导者（无论在食品还是能源领域）共有的理想主义。虚荣心是永恒的；人们只有在不得不可持续购物时，才会开始这样做。

Text 2   广告追踪与"禁止追踪"之争（26–30）

An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted—the trouble is, no one knows which half. In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced. By watching what people search for, click on and say online, companies can aim "behavioural" ads at those most likely to buy.

有句老话说，一半的广告预算都打了水漂——问题是，没人知道是哪一半。在互联网时代，至少在理论上，这一浪费可以大大减少。通过观察人们在网上搜索什么、点击什么、说什么，企业可以把"行为"广告精准地投放给那些最有可能购买的人。

In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioural ads? Or should they have explicit permission?

在过去几周里，一场争论说明了这种精细信息对广告商的价值：广告商是否可以假定人们乐于被追踪、被发送行为广告？还是说他们必须获得明确许可？

In December 2010 America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a "do not track" (DNT) option to internet browsers, so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed. Microsoft's Internet Explorer and Apple's Safari both offer DNT; Google's Chrome is due to do so this year. In February the FTC and Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) agreed that the industry would get cracking on responding to DNT requests.

2010年12月，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）提议在互联网浏览器中增加"禁止追踪"（DNT）选项，以便用户可以告诉广告商他们不想被追踪。微软的IE浏览器和苹果的Safari浏览器都提供DNT；谷歌的Chrome浏览器也将于今年跟进。2月，FTC与数字广告联盟（DAA）达成一致，该行业将着手响应DNT请求。

On May 31st Microsoft set off the row. It said that Internet Explorer 10, the version due to appear with Windows 8, would have DNT as a default.

5月31日，微软率先发难。它宣布，将随Windows 8推出的IE 10浏览器将把DNT设为默认选项。

Advertisers are horrified. Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings. Few switch DNT on now, but if tracking is off it will stay off. Bob Liodice, the chief executive of the Association of National Advertisers, says consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information about their preferences. People will not get fewer ads, he says. "They'll get less meaningful, less targeted ads."

广告商们吓坏了。人性使然，大多数人都会保持默认设置。现在很少有人打开DNT，但如果追踪默认关闭，它就一直关着。美国广告主协会首席执行官鲍勃·利奥迪奇说，如果广告行业无法收集用户偏好信息，消费者的处境会更糟。他说，人们收到的广告不会变少，"只会变成更没意义、更不精准的广告。"

It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond. Getting a DNT signal does not oblige anyone to stop tracking, although some companies have promised to do so. Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioural ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft's default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.

广告商将作何回应尚不清楚。收到DNT信号并不强制任何人停止追踪，尽管有些公司已承诺会这么做。由于无法判断某人是真的反对行为广告，还是只是沿用微软的默认设置，有些公司可能会无视DNT信号，照常追踪。

Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone. After all, it has an ad business too, which it says will comply with DNT requests, though it is still working out how. If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: there is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm. DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8—though the firm has compared some of its other products favourably with Google's on that count before. Brendon Lynch, Microsoft's chief privacy officer, blogged: "We believe consumers should have more control." Could it really be that simple?

同样不清楚的是，微软为何要独自行动。毕竟它自己也有广告业务，它说会遵守DNT请求，尽管还在研究如何做到。如果它是想给几乎完全依赖广告的谷歌制造麻烦，那它选了一个间接的办法：没人能保证默认DNT会成为行业规范。DNT对Windows 8来说似乎算不上一个明显巨大的卖点——尽管微软之前曾在这一点上把自己的其他产品比谷歌的产品夸了一通。微软首席隐私官布兰登·林奇在博客中写道："我们认为消费者应该拥有更多控制权。"事情真有这么简单吗？

26

Text 3   人类未来展望：乐观还是悲观（31–35）

Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely—though by no means uniformly—glowingly positive. Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfillment and opportunity for all.

直到几十年前，我们对未来的展望尽管并非完全一致，但总体上是极其乐观的。科学技术会治愈人类的一切弊病，让所有人都过上充实而充满机遇的生活。

Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change. You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.

如今，随着我们对自身面临的一系列威胁——从小行星撞击到流感大流行再到气候变化——有了更深刻的认识，乌托邦已经不再时髦。你甚至可能忍不住认为，人类已经没什么未来可期待了。

But such gloominess is misplaced. The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years—so why shouldn't we? Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years. Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the International Union for the Conversation of Nature (IUCN), and you will read: "Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline."

但这种悲观是放错了地方。化石记录表明，许多物种已经存活了数百万年——那我们人类为什么不能呢？放眼看看我们这个物种在宇宙中的位置，就会清楚地发现，我们即便不能存活几十万年，也极有可能存活数万年。在国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）濒危物种"红色名录"中查一查"智人"，你会读到："被列为无危物种，因为该物种分布极广、适应性强、目前数量仍在增长，且不存在导致种群整体下降的重大威胁。"

So what does our deep future hold? A growing number of researchers and organisations are now thinking seriously about that question. For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.

那么，我们遥远的未来会是什么样子？越来越多的研究者和组织现在正在认真思考这个问题。例如，恒今基金会把一座机械钟作为旗舰项目，这座钟被设计成在几千年后仍能计时。

Perhaps willfully, it may be easier to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future. The potential evolution of today's technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage. That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.

或许有些刻意，思考如此漫长的时间跨度可能比思考更近期的未来更容易。当今技术的潜在演进及其社会后果复杂得令人眼花缭乱，也许最好把我们所能设想的种种可能性留给科幻作家和未来学家去探索。这就是我们创办《Arc》这本致力于探讨近期未来的新刊物的原因之一。

But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance. As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.

但从更长远的视角看，我们可以相当有把握地言说的事情多得惊人。正如往常一样，过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙：我们现在已经充分识别了塑造地球和人类历史的长期模式，足以对后代将身处的处境做出有依据的预测。

This long perspective makes the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad. To be sure, the future is not all rosy. But we are now knowledgeable enough to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans, and to improve the lot of those to come.

这种长远视角使对前景悲观看法更像是一时的时髦。诚然，未来并非一片光明。但我们现在已经足够睿智，能够降低曾威胁早期人类生存的许多风险，并改善后代的命运。

31

Text 4   亚利桑那州移民法与联邦权力（36–40）

On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday—a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration. But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.

周一，最高法院以5:3的投票结果否决了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分内容——这对奥巴马政府来说是一次不大不小的政策胜利。但在更重要的宪法问题上，最高法院以8:0裁定奥巴马政府试图打破联邦政府与各州之间权力平衡的努力失败。

In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law. The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial. Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.

在亚利桑那州诉美国案中，多数法官推翻了亚利桑那州那项允许州和地方警察执行联邦移民法的争议性计划中四项受质疑条款的三项。宪法原则——只有华盛顿有权"制定统一的归化规则"，且联邦法律优先于州法律——是毫无争议的。亚利桑那州试图制定与现行联邦政策并行的州级政策。

Justice Anthony Kennedy, joined by Chief Justice John Roberts and the Court's liberals, ruled that the state flew too close to the federal sun. On the overturned provisions the majority held that Congress had deliberately "occupied the field," and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.

安东尼·肯尼迪大法官在首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨和法院自由派的支持下裁定，亚利桑那州离联邦太阳飞得太近了。在被推翻的条款上，多数法官认为国会已经有意"占据了这一领域"，因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦的特权。

However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement. That's because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with their federal colleagues.

然而，法官们表示，亚利桑那州警方将被允许核查与执法部门接触人员的合法身份。这是因为国会一直设想联邦与州联合执行移民法，并明确鼓励州政府官员与联邦同僚共享信息、展开合作。

Two of the three objecting Justices—Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas—agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute. The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.

三位持异议的大法官中有两位——塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯——同意这一宪法逻辑，但在亚利桑那州哪些条款与联邦法规相抵触上存在分歧。唯一的重大异议来自大法官安东宁·斯卡利亚，他为可追溯到《客籍法和惩治煽动叛乱法》的州权提供了更为强有力的辩护。

The 8-0 objection to President Obama turns on what Justice Samuel Alito describes in his objection as "a shocking assertion of federal executive power." The White House argued that Arizona's laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter. In effect, the White House claimed that it could invalidate any otherwise legitimate state law that it disagrees with.

这次8:0反对奥巴马总统的裁决，关键在于塞缪尔·阿利托大法官在异议中所称的"对联邦行政权力的令人震惊的主张"。白宫辩称，亚利桑那州的法律与其执法优先次序相冲突，即便州法律在字面上完全符合联邦法规。实际上，白宫声称它可以废除任何它不认同的、在其他方面合法的州法律。

Some powers do belong exclusively to the federal government, and control of citizenship and the borders is among them. But if Congress wanted to prevent states from using their own resources to check immigration status, it could. It never did so. The Administration was in essence asserting that because it didn't want to carry out Congress's immigration wishes, no state should be allowed to do so either. Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim.

有些权力确实只属于联邦政府，对公民身份和边界的控制就在其中。但如果国会想阻止各州动用自身资源核查移民身份，它是可以做到的。它从来没有这么做。政府实质上是在声称：因为它自己不想执行国会的移民意愿，所以也不允许任何州这么做。每位大法官都理所当然地驳回了这一非同寻常的主张。

36

Part B · 新题型七选五（41–45）

【题目】社会科学蓬勃发展，但未充分应对全球挑战。从A-G中选5段填入空白，两个干扰项。

文章脉络：社会科学繁荣→但未贡献于全球挑战→问题根源在人类行为→社会科学家却不愿应对→论文虽多但影响有限→资金不是问题，问题在方向→应引导资金跨学科整合→最终形成协作项目解决全球问题。

Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G
A
It could be that we are evolving two communities of social scientists: one that is discipline-oriented and publishing in highly specialized journals, and one that is problem-oriented and publishing elsewhere, such as policy briefs.
有可能我们正在演化出两类社会科学家的群体：一类以学科为导向，在高度专业化的期刊上发表；另一类以问题为导向，在其他地方（如政策简报）发表。
B
However, the numbers are still small: in 2010, about 1,600 of the 100,000 social-sciences papers published globally included one of these keywords.
然而，数量仍然很小：2010年全球发表的10万篇社会科学论文中，只有约1600篇包含上述关键词之一。
C
Despite these factors, many social scientists seem reluctant to tackle such problems. And in Europe, some are up in arms over a proposal to drop a specific funding category for social-science research and to integrate it within cross-cutting topics of sustainable development.
尽管有这些因素，许多社会科学家似乎仍不愿着手此类问题。在欧洲，一些人还强烈反对一项提议——取消对社会科学研究的专项资助类别，将其并入可持续发展的跨领域主题之中。
D
During the late 1990s, national spending on social sciences and the humanities as a percentage of all research and development funds—including government, higher education, non-profit and corporate—varied from around 4% to 25%; in most European nations, it is about 15%.
20世纪90年代末，各国在社会科学和人文学科上的支出占全部研发经费（含政府、高等教育、非营利机构和企业）的比重，在约4%到25%之间浮动；在大多数欧洲国家约为15%。
E
The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories, including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio-economy, clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
其用意是迫使社会科学家把工作与其他类别相融合，这些类别包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效的能源，以及包容、创新且安全的社会。
F
The solution is to change the mindset of the academic community, and what it considers to be its main goal. Global challenges and social innovation ought to receive much more attention from scientists, especially the young ones.
解决之道在于改变学术共同体的心态，以及它所认定的主要目标。全球挑战与社会创新理应得到科学家——尤其是年轻科学家——更多的关注。
G
These issues all have root causes in human behavior: all require behavioral change and social innovations, as well as technological development. Stemming climate change, for example, is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
这些问题都根植于人类行为：它们都需要行为改变与社会创新，也需要技术发展。例如，遏制气候变化，既关乎改变消费模式、促进税收认同，也关乎开发清洁能源。
41
句子还原题
答案 E
匹配依据[E] 这些问题根源都在人类行为：都需要行为改变和社会创新，以及技术发展。例如，减缓气候变化既关乎改变消费模式和推动税收接受度，也关乎发展清洁能源。→ 上文列举气候变化、安全等全球挑战，E紧承说这些问题的根源都在人类行为。
42
句子还原题
答案 F
匹配依据[F] 尽管有这些因素，许多社会科学家似乎不愿应对这些问题。在欧洲，一些人因提议取消专门的社会科学资金类别、将其并入可持续发展跨领域课题而激烈抗议。→ 后句"This is a shame"（这是耻辱），正是指社会科学家不愿应对问题。
43
句子还原题
答案 B
匹配依据[B] 然而，数量仍然很小：2010年全球发表的10万篇社会科学论文中，只有约1600篇包含其中一个关键词。→ 上文说含"环境变化""气候变化"关键词的论文自2004年快速增长，B用"然而"转折：数量仍然很小。
44
句子还原题
答案 G
匹配依据[G] 20世纪90年代末，社会科学和人文学科国家支出占研发资金总额比例从约4%到25%不等；在大多数欧洲国家约为15%。→ 上文说问题不一定是可用资金多少，G给出具体资金数字；后句"这个数额只要方向对就足够"。
45
句子还原题
答案 C
匹配依据[C] 这个想法是迫使社会科学家将其工作与其他类别整合，包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效能源以及包容、创新和安全的社会。→ 上文说意图不是忽视社会科学，而是完全相反；后句说"这应促成更多协作项目"。C解释整合的具体内容。
干扰项[A] 我们正演变为两类社会科学家；[D] 解决方案是改变学术界心态。两项均不贴合上下文逻辑。
Part C · 英译汉逐句翻译（46–50）
46
翻译
yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression.
然而，只要看看无家可归者创造的花园的照片，你就会意识到：尽管样式各异，这些花园除了表达装饰和创造性表达之外，还传达着人类其他各种根本的渴望。
采分点① it strikes one that 人们突然意识到；② for all 尽管；③ diversity of styles 样式多样；④ speak of 传达。
47
翻译
A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need.
无论多么简陋，一片宁静的圣地是人类独有的需求，而庇护所则是动物独有的需求。
采分点① sacred place 圣地；② crude 简陋的；③ distinctly 独特地；④ as opposed to 与……相对。
48
翻译
The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environment where it either didn't exist or was not discernible as such.
无家可归者的花园实际上就是无家之园，它们给城市环境引入了一种形式，这种形式要么原本不存在，要么无法被这样辨认出来。
采分点① in effect 实际上；② discernible 可辨认的；③ as such 照此本身。
49
翻译
most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic.
我们大多数人会陷入精神萎靡，通常将其归咎于某种心理状态，直到有一天我们置身花园，才会感觉烦闷感像变魔术一样消失了。
采分点① give in to 陷入/屈服于；② demoralization of spirit 精神萎靡；③ blame on 归咎于；④ as if by magic 像变魔术一样。
50
翻译
It is this implicit or explicit reference to nature that fully justifies the use of the word garden, though in a "liberated" sense, to describe these synthetic constructions.
正是这种对自然的或含蓄或明确的参照，充分证明了用"花园"一词（尽管是在"广义"上）来描述这些人造建筑是完全合理的。
采分点① 强调句 It is...that...；② implicit/explicit 含蓄/明确；③ justify 证明合理；④ synthetic constructions 人造建筑。
Section III · Writing 写作
Part A 小作文（10分）— 邀请外教担任评委

原题指令 Directions

Write an email to a foreign teacher in your department, inviting him/her to be a judge for the upcoming English speech contest. You should include any details that you think necessary. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead.

【译文】给你所在院系的一位外教写一封电子邮件，邀请他/她担任即将举行的英语演讲比赛的评委。可包含你认为必要的细节。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。

题目

给你们学院的一位外教写一封约100词的电子邮件，邀请他/她担任即将到来的英语演讲比赛的评委。包含你认为必要的细节。落款Li Ming。

审题

① 格式：邮件；② 内容：邀请+比赛时间地点+评委职责+期待回复；③ 语气：礼貌诚恳。

参考范文

Dear Professor Smith,

I am Li Ming, a student from the English Department. On behalf of the Students' Union, I am writing to sincerely invite you to serve as a judge for our upcoming English speech contest.

The contest will be held in the Lecture Hall on the second floor of the Student Activity Center on the morning of June 15. Ten finalists will deliver speeches on the topic "My Dream, My China." We would be deeply honored if you could spare some time to evaluate their performance and offer valuable comments. Your presence will surely inspire all the participants.

We would greatly appreciate it if you could confirm your availability at your earliest convenience. Looking forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely, Li Ming

【译文】

尊敬的史密斯教授：

我是英语系的李明。我谨代表学生会，诚挚邀请您担任即将举行的英语演讲比赛的评委。

比赛将于6月15日上午在学生活动中心二楼的演讲厅举行。十位决赛选手将围绕"我的中国梦"主题发表演讲。若您能拨冗评审他们的表现并给出宝贵意见，我们将深感荣幸。您的出席必将激励所有参赛者。

如蒙尽快告知能否出席，我们将不胜感激。期待您的回复。

谨上，李明

Part B 大作文（20分）— 毕业生的选择

原题指令 Directions

Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows a group of graduates standing at a crossroads, each wearing a sign reading "Graduate". Before them lie four different roads marked "Job hunting", "Postgraduate exam", "Studying abroad" and "Starting a business". The title is "Choice".

【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 图中一群刚毕业的学生站在岔路口，每人头上都顶着写有“毕业生”的牌子。前方四条路分别写着“求职”“考研”“出国”“创业”。标题：选择。

图画描述

图中一群刚毕业的学生站在一个岔路口，每人头上都顶着写有"毕业生"的牌子。前方有四条不同的路，分别写着"求职""考研""出国""创业"。标题：选择。

审题框架

三段式：①描述图画（毕业生站在人生岔路口面临多种选择）；②阐释寓意（人生关键期的选择至关重要，要结合自身实际理性规划）；③评论（没有最好的选择，只有最适合自己的）。160-200词。

参考范文

The cartoon vividly depicts a group of fresh graduates standing at a crossroads, each wearing a sign that reads "graduate." Before them lie four divergent paths labeled "job hunting," "pursuing postgraduate studies," "going abroad," and "starting a business." The caption reads simply: choice.

The drawing captures a defining moment in every young person's life: upon graduation, we are suddenly confronted with a dizzying array of paths. This is both exciting and daunting, because the decisions made at this turning point may shape the rest of our careers. Yet the picture also carries a reassuring message: there is no single "correct" road. What truly matters is not which path we take, but whether we know ourselves well enough to choose the one that fits our interests, strengths and ambitions.

From my perspective, before making the final decision, graduates should reflect honestly on their personality, financial situation and long-term goals. Whichever road they take, determination and perseverance matter more than the choice itself. As long as they commit wholeheartedly, every path can lead to a bright future.

【译文】

漫画生动地描绘了一群应届毕业生站在人生的十字路口，每人头上都顶着写有"毕业生"的牌子。他们面前有四条岔路，分别写着"求职""考研""出国"和"创业"。图题只有两个字：选择。

这幅画捕捉了每个年轻人生命中的关键时刻：毕业之际，我们突然面对令人眼花缭乱的无数条道路。这既令人兴奋又令人忐忑，因为这一转折点的抉择可能塑造我们余下的职业生涯。然而画面也传递着令人安心的讯息：世上没有唯一"正确"的路。真正重要的不是我们选了哪条路，而是我们是否足够了解自己，从而选到契合自身兴趣、优势与抱负的那一条。

在我看来，毕业生在最终决定前应诚实审视自己的性格、经济状况与长远目标。无论走哪条路，决心与坚持都比选择本身更重要。只要全心投入，每条路都能通向光明的未来。

Section I   Use of English · 完形填空逐句精读

As many people hit middle age, they often start to notice that their memory and mental clarity are not what they used to be. We suddenly can't remember 1 we put the keys just a moment ago, or an old acquaintance's name, or the name of an old band we used to love. As the brain 2, we refer to these occurrences as "senior moments." 3 seemingly innocent, this loss of mental focus can potentially have a(n) 4 impact on our professional, social, and personal 5.

许多人到了中年，往往开始注意到记忆力和思维清晰度大不如前。我们突然想不起刚才把钥匙放在哪里，或是一位老熟人的名字，或是曾经喜爱的某支老乐队的名字。随着大脑衰退，我们把这些现象称为"老年时刻"。尽管看似无伤大雅，但这种注意力的丧失可能会对我们的职业、社会和个人福祉造成破坏性影响。

Neuroscientists, experts who study the nervous system, are increasingly showing that there's actually a lot that can be done. It 6 out that the brain needs exercise in much the same way our muscles do, and the right mental 7 can significantly improve our basic cognitive 8. Thinking is essentially a 9 of making connections in the brain. To a certain extent, our ability to 10 in making the connections that drive intelligence is inherited. 11, because these connections are made through effort and practice, scientists believe that intelligence can expand and fluctuate 12 mental effort.

神经科学家——研究神经系统的专家——越来越多地表明，实际上我们可以做很多事情。事实证明，大脑像肌肉一样需要锻炼，而恰当的脑力训练可以显著改善我们的基本认知功能。思考本质上是在大脑中建立连接的过程。在一定程度上，我们擅长建立这些驱动智力的连接的能力是遗传的。然而，由于这些连接是通过努力和练习建立的，科学家认为智力可以根据脑力投入而扩展和波动。

Now, a new Web-based company has taken it a step 13 and developed the first "brain training program" designed to actually help people improve and regain their mental 14.

如今，一家新兴的网络公司更进一步，开发出了首个"大脑训练程序"，其设计初衷是真正帮助人们改善并恢复思维敏锐度。

The Web-based program 15 you to systematically improve your memory and attention skills. The program keeps 16 of your progress and provides detailed feedback 17 your performance and improvement. Most importantly, it 18 modifies and enhances the games you play to 19 on the strengths you are developing—much like a(n) 20 exercise routine requires you to increase resistance and vary your muscle use.

这个网络程序让你能够系统性地改善记忆力和注意力。它会跟踪你的进步，并就你的表现和提升提供详细反馈。最重要的是，它会不断调整并升级你所玩的游戏，以巩固你正在发展的优势——就像一套有效的日常锻炼要求你增加阻力并变换肌肉使用方式一样。

从句引导词题
答案 D where

Reading Part A · Text 1 逐句精读

In order to "change lives for the better" and reduce "dependency," George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, introduced the "upfront work search" scheme. Only if the jobless arrive at the jobcentre with a CV, register for online job search, and start looking for work will they be eligible for benefit—and then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly. What could be more reasonable?

为了"让生活变得更好"并减少"依赖"，英国财政大臣乔治·奥斯本推出了"先期求职"计划。只有当失业者带着简历来到就业中心、注册在线求职、并开始找工作时，他们才有资格领取救济金——而且此后应每周而非每两周报到一次。还有什么比这更合理呢？

More apparent reasonableness followed. There will now be a seven-day wait for the jobseeker's allowance. "Those first few days should be spent looking for work, not looking to sign on," he claimed. "We're doing these things because we know they help people stay off benefits and help those on benefits get into work faster." Help? Really? On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness. What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for "fundamental fairness"—protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits.

接下来还有更多表面上的合理之处。现在求职者津贴要等七天才能领取。"头几天应该用来找工作，而不是登记领取救济，"他声称。"我们做这些事，是因为我们知道这能帮助人们不依赖救济，也能帮助靠救济的人更快就业。"帮助？真的吗？乍听之下，这是一位心系社会的财政大臣，试图让生活变得更好，还对一个明显纵容新失业者找工作不够努力、补贴懒惰的制度进行了"改革"。我们被引导去理解，激励他的是对"基本公平"的热忱——保护纳税人、控制开支，并确保只有最值得救济的申请人才能拿到福利。

Losing a job is hurting: you don't skip down to the jobcentre with a song in your heart, delighted at the prospect of doubling your income from the generous state. It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and you know that support is minimal and extraordinarily hard to get. You are now not wanted; you are now excluded from the work environment that offers purpose and structure in your life. Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared. Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.

失去工作是痛苦的：你不会哼着歌蹦蹦跳跳地去就业中心，为能从慷慨的国家那里让收入翻倍而欣喜。这在经济上令人恐惧，在心理上令人尴尬，而且你知道补助少得可怜又极难拿到。你现在不被需要；你被从那个给你生活意义和结构的工作环境中驱逐了。更糟的是，用来养活自己和家人、支付账单的关键收入消失了。问任何一个刚失业的人想要什么，答案永远是：一份工作。

But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency—permanent dependency if you can get it—supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood. It is as though 20 years of ever-tougher reforms of the job search and benefit administration system never happened. The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment and receive unconditional payments if the disaster happens. Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions. Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited "allowance," conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.

但在奥斯本的世界里，你的第一反应是陷入依赖——如果能拿到就是永久依赖——由一个急于纵容你谎言的国家供养。就好像过去20年对求职和救济管理系统不断加码的改革从未发生过。英国福利的原则已不再是你可以为失业风险投保、灾难发生时无条件领取救济。就连"求职者津贴"这个说法本身，就是要把失业者重新定义为"求职者"，他们对自己通过缴纳国民保险而挣得的救济没有基本权利。相反，申请人领取的是一份有期限的"津贴"，以积极找工作为条件；没有应得权利，没有保险，每周71.70英镑，是欧盟最不慷慨的救济金之一。

21
细节题
答案 C
George Osborne's scheme was intended to ___.乔治·奥斯本（ George Osborne ）的计划旨在___。
[A] motivate the unemployed to report voluntarily.激励失业者主动报告。
[B] provide the unemployed with easier access to benefits.让失业者更便捷地获取救济金。
[C] encourage jobseekers' active engagement in job seeking.
[D] guarantee jobseekers' legitimate right to benefits.保障求职者领取福利的合法权利。
💡 考场思路首段：要求失业者带简历、注册在线求职、开始找工作才有资格领救济。目的就是"鼓励积极找工作"。
逐项分析 [A] 自愿报到 → 原文要求 weekly 强制报到，错；
[B] 更容易拿救济 → 原文是加了条件、等7天，是更难拿；
[C] 鼓励积极求职 → 正确，对应 start looking for work；
[D] 保障救济权利 → 与原文"no entitlement"相反。
核心词汇
Chancellor of the Exchequer 财政大臣
eligible adj. 有资格的
dependency n. 依赖
subsidise v. 补贴
indulgent adj. 纵容的
claimant n. 申请人
22

答案 A

[B] to accept the government's restrictions on the allowance.接受政府对津贴的限制。
[C] to check on the availability of jobs at the jobcentre.查看就业中心职位的空缺情况。
[D] to attend a governmental job-training program.参加政府就业培训项目。
💡 考场思路sign on 与 looking for work 对比："头几天应该用来找工作，而不是 sign on"——sign on 就是去登记领救济金。
逐项分析 [A] 登记领政府津贴 → 正确；
[B] 接受政府限制 → 这不是 sign on 的含义；
[C] 查询工作 → 与 looking for work 同义，不是对比项；
[D] 参加培训 → 无中生有。
23
细节题
答案 D
What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme?是什么促使财政大臣制定了他的计划？

[D] A passion to ensure fairness for taxpayers.
💡 考场思路第二段末："his zeal for 'fundamental fairness'—protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending"——动机是对纳税人公平的热忱。
逐项分析 [A] 为所有人更好生活 → 这是 Osborne 自我标榜，不是真正动机；

答案 A

Text 2   美国法律行业成本高企的原因与改革（26–30）

All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession—with the possible exception of journalism. But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.

在世界各地，律师比其他任何职业的从业者都更容易招致敌意——新闻记者可能是唯一的例外。但几乎没有哪个地方的客户比美国的客户更有理由抱怨。

During the decade before the economic crisis, spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation. The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools. But most law graduates never get a big-firm job. Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.

在经济危机爆发前的十年里，美国法律服务支出的增长速度是通货膨胀的两倍。最优秀的律师赚得盆满钵满，吸引着越来越多的学生涌入法学院。但大多数法学毕业生从未得到大律所的工作。他们中的许多人反而成了那种麻烦诉讼的提起者，使侵权制度成了一场代价高昂的噩梦。

There are many reasons for this. One is the excessive costs of a legal education. There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states: a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject, then a three-year law degree at one of 200 law schools authorized by the American Bar Association and an expensive preparation for the bar exam. This leaves today's average law-school graduate with $100,000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts. Law-school debt means that they have to work fearsomely hard.

这其中有很多原因。其一，法律教育成本过高。在美国大多数州，成为律师只有一条路：先在某个不相关专业读四年本科，然后在美国律师协会授权的200所法学院之一读三年法律学位，再花一大笔钱准备律师资格考试。这使得今天普通法学院毕业生在本科债务之外又背了10万美元的债。法学院的债务意味着他们必须拼命工作。

Reforming the system would help both lawyers and their customers. Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them. One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree. Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school. If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so. Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.

改革这一制度对律师和客户都有好处。一些明智的想法已经存在很久了，但管理该行业的州级机构过于保守，迟迟不肯实施。一个想法是允许人们本科就读法律专业。另一个想法是让学生在法学院读满两年后就能参加律师考试。如果律师考试对未来律师真的是足够严格的测试，那么那些能够更早参加考试的人就应该被允许这样做。不需要额外培训的学生可以将他们的债务大山削减三分之一。

The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business. Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm. This keeps fees high and innovation slow. There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.

成本如此之高的另一个原因是该行业限制性的、行会式的所有权结构。除哥伦比亚特区外，非律师不得持有律所任何股份。这使得费用居高不下、创新缓慢。行业内部存在要求变革的压力，但监管机构中的反对者坚持认为，将外部人士挡在律所之外，可以使律师免于赚钱的压力，从而更道德地服务客户。

In fact, allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms would reduce costs and improve services to customers, by encouraging law firms to use technology and to employ professional managers to focus on improving firms' efficiency. After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions. America should follow.

事实上，允许非律师持有律所股份将降低成本、改善对客户的服务，因为这会鼓励律所使用技术、聘请职业经理人专注于提高效率。毕竟，澳大利亚、英国等其他国家已经开始放开对法律行业的限制。美国也应该跟上。

26
细节题

A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ___.由于___ ，许多学生以法律为职业。
[A] the growing demand from clients.客户日益增长的需求。

[C] the prospect of working in big firms.在大型企业工作的前景。
[D] the attraction of financial rewards.
💡 考场思路第二段："The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools"——最优秀律师赚大钱，吸引学生涌入法学院。
逐项分析 [A] 客户需求增长 → 未提及；
[B] 通胀压力 → 原文 spending grew twice as fast as inflation 是支出增速，不是学生选法律的原因；

[D] 经济回报的吸引力 → 正确，对应 skyscrapers-full of money。
核心词汇
hostility n. 敌意
tort n. 侵权
excessive adj. 过度的
guild-like adj. 行会式的
liberalize v. 放开/自由化
conservative adj. 保守的

Text 3   新兴科学奖与诺贝尔奖之辩（31–35）

The US $3-million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year's award in March. And it is far from the only one of its type. As a News Feature article in Nature discusses, a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes in recent years. Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs. These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.

正如亚历山大·波利亚科夫在今年3月领奖时所说，300万美元的"基础物理学奖"确实是一个有趣的尝试。但它远非同类奖项中的唯一一个。正如《自然》杂志一篇新闻特写所讨论的，近年来一系列为研究者设立的丰厚奖项已经加入了诺贝尔奖的行列。其中许多奖项，如基础物理学奖，资金都来自互联网企业家那些电话号码般长的银行账户。这些捐助者在自己的领域获得了成功，他们想用自己的财富让人们关注那些在科学上取得成功的人。

What's not to like? Quite a lot, according to a handful of scientists quoted in the News Feature. You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels. The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them, say scientists. They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research. They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research. They do not fund peer-reviewed research. They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.

有什么不讨人喜欢的呢？据这篇特写引用的少数科学家说，不讨人喜欢的地方还真不少。正如老话说的，你买不来阶层，这些暴发户企业家也买不来他们奖项身上诺贝尔奖那样的声望。科学家们说，这些新奖项是其幕后推手的自我炒作。它们可能扭曲以成就为基础、由同行评审主导的研究体系。它们可能巩固同行评审研究的现状。它们并不资助同行评审研究。它们还延续了"孤胆天才"的神话。

The goals of the prize-givers seem as scattered as the criticism. Some want to shock, others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.

颁奖者的目标似乎和批评意见一样五花八门。有人想制造轰动，有人想吸引人们投身科学，还有人想更好地回报那些以研究为事业的人。

As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes—both new and old—are distributed. The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include. But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research—as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson. The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided what he wanted to do with his own money. Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.

正如《自然》杂志此前指出的，人们对科学奖项——无论新旧——如何分配存在一些合理担忧。今年设立的"生命科学突破奖"对生命科学包含的范围持一种不具代表性的看法。但诺贝尔基金会对每项奖最多三名获奖者、且每位必须在世的限制，早已被现代研究的协作性质所超越——在表彰希格斯玻色子的发现时，谁被忽略了所引发的不可避免的争执将证明这一点。当然，诺贝尔奖本身也是由一位非常富有的人设立的，他决定用自己的钱做什么。赋予诺贝尔奖合法性的，是时间而非初衷。

As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem clear. First, most researchers would accept such a prize if they were offered one. Second, it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere. It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism—that is the culture of research, after all—but it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please. It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.

尽管一些科学家可能会抱怨这些新奖项，但有两点似乎很清楚。第一，如果真有这样的奖，大多数研究者都会接受。第二，金钱和关注流向科学而不是别处，这肯定是件好事。批评和质疑这种机制是公平的——毕竟这就是研究文化——但这是颁奖者自己的钱，他们想怎么用就怎么用。怀着感激和优雅接受这样的馈赠才是明智之举。

31

[A] a symbol of the entrepreneurs' wealth.企业家财富的象征。

[B] 可能替代诺贝尔奖 → 原文 joined the Nobel Prizes，不是 replacement；

核心词汇
lucrative adj. 赚钱的/丰厚的
upstart n. 暴发户
prestige n. 声望
perpetuate v. 使永存
legitimate adj. 合理的/合法的
recipients n. 获奖者

Text 4   AAAS报告《问题的核心》与自由教育危机（36–40）

"The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America. Regrettably, however, the report's failure to address the true nature of the crisis facing liberal education may cause more harm than good.

美国文理研究院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》值得称赞，因为它肯定了人文社会科学对美国自由民主的繁荣与安全的重要性。然而令人遗憾的是，该报告未能触及自由教育所面临危机的真正本质，可能弊大于利。

In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking that it identify actions that could be taken by "federal, state and local governments, universities, foundations, educators, individual benefactors and others" to "maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education." In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences. Among the commission's 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars, lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism.

2010年，国会民主党和共和党领袖致信AAAS，要求其明确"联邦、州和地方政府、大学、基金会、教育工作者、个人捐助者及其他各方"可采取哪些行动，以"保持国家在人文和社会科学学术与教育领域的卓越地位"。作为回应，美国文理研究院成立了人文与社会科学委员会。委员会的51名成员包括顶尖大学校长、学者、律师、法官、企业高管，以及来自外交、电影、音乐和新闻界的杰出人物。

The goals identified in the report are generally admirable. Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies. To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day. The report also advocates greater study of foreign languages, international affairs and the expansion of study abroad programs.

报告中确定的目标总体上令人钦佩。因为代议制政府的前提是知情的公民群体，报告支持全民读写能力；强调历史与政府研究，尤其是美国历史和美国政府；并鼓励使用新数字技术。为鼓励创新和竞争，报告呼吁增加研究投资、精心设计连贯课程以提升21世纪学生解决问题和有效沟通的能力、增加教师经费、鼓励学者用所学应对当今重大挑战。报告还提倡加强外语、国际事务学习并扩大留学项目。

Unfortunately, despite 2½ years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities. The commission ignores that for several decades America's colleges and universities have produced graduates who don't know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits. Sadly, the spirit of inquiry once at home on campus has been replaced by the use of the humanities and social sciences as vehicles for publicizing "progressive," or left-liberal propaganda.

不幸的是，尽管耗时两年半制作，《问题的核心》却从未触及问题的核心：我们顶尖高校中自由教育的非自由本质。委员会忽略了一个事实：几十年来，美国高校培养的毕业生并不了解自由教育的内容与特征，因而被剥夺了其益处。可悲的是，曾经盛行于校园的探究精神，已经被将人文社会科学用作宣传"进步主义"或左翼自由派思想的工具所取代。

Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas—such as free markets and self-reliance—as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.

如今，教授们通常将对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义公共政策视为正当研究课题，而将保守或古典自由主义思想——如自由市场和自立——描绘为超出常规、甚至是不合法的知识探究范畴。

The AAAS displays great enthusiasm for liberal education. Yet its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge that Congress asked it to illuminate.

AAAS对自由教育表现出极大热情。然而，其报告可能会因掩盖国会要求其阐明的挑战的深度和广度而阻碍改革。

36
态度题
答案 A

[C] Contemptuous.轻蔑的；鄙视的。

[B] 欣赏的 → 只看到前半句 deserves praise，忽略转折；

核心词汇

Part B · 新题型排序题（41–45）

【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。

已知位置：41 → A → 42 → E → 43 → 44 → 45

解题关键：A段讲"有些遗址显眼（帕特农、金字塔、巨石阵），但多数是仔细搜索或偶然发现的（奥杜威峡谷、墨西哥城地铁）"；E段讲"今天考古学家依靠系统调查方法和高科技工具（机载雷达、航空摄影）"。

Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G
A
Some archaeological sites have always been easily observable—for example, the Parthenon in Athens, Greece; the pyramids of Giza in Egypt; and the megaliths of Stonehenge in southern England. But these sites are exceptions to the norm. Most archaeological sites have been located by means of careful searching, while many others have been discovered by accident. Olduvai Gorge, in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911. Thousands of Aztec artifacts came to light during the digging of the Mexico City subway in the 1970s.
有些考古遗址向来易于观察——例如希腊雅典的帕特农神庙、埃及的吉萨金字塔，以及英格兰南部的巨石阵。但这些遗址只是常态中的例外。多数考古遗址是通过仔细搜寻定位的，而许多其他遗址则是偶然发现的。坦桑尼亚的奥杜威峡谷，是一位蝴蝶猎人在1911年失足跌入其深谷时被发现的。数千件阿兹特克文物则是在1970年代修建墨西哥城地铁时被发掘出来的。
B
In another case, American archaeologists René million and George Cowgill spent years systematically mapping the entire city of Teotihuacan in the valley of Mexico near what is now Mexico City. At its peak around AD 600, this city was one of the largest human settlements in the world. The researchers mapped not only the city's vast and ornate ceremonial areas, but also hundreds of simpler apartment complexes where common people lived.
另有一例，美国考古学家勒内·米永和乔治·考吉尔耗时数年，系统测绘了如今墨西哥城附近墨西哥谷地中的特奥蒂瓦坎古城。公元600年前后鼎盛期，该城曾是世界上最大的人类聚居地之一。研究者不仅测绘了这座城市宏大而华丽的礼仪区，也测绘了数百座普通民众居住的相对简陋的公寓建筑群。
C
How do archaeologists know where to find what they are looking for when there is nothing visible on the surface of the ground? Typically, they survey and sample (make test excavations on) large areas of terrain to determine where excavation will yield useful information. Surveys and test samples have also become important for understanding the larger landscapes that contain archaeological sites.
当地表上看不到任何东西时，考古学家如何知道去哪里寻找目标？通常，他们会对大片区域进行勘测与取样（即进行试掘），以确定何处发掘能产出有用信息。勘测与试掘对于理解包含考古遗址的更广阔地貌也变得十分重要。
D
Surveys can cover a single large settlement or entire landscapes. In one case, many researchers working around the ancient Maya city of Copán, Honduras, have located hundreds of small rural village and individual dwellings by using aerial photographs and by making surveys on foot. The resulting settlement maps show how the distribution and density of the rural population around the city changed dramatically between AD500 and 850, when Copán collapsed.
勘测可以覆盖单个大型聚落，也可以覆盖整片地貌。有一例中，许多围绕洪都拉斯科潘玛雅古城工作的研究者，借助航拍照片和步行勘测，定位了数百个小型乡村聚落与独立居所。由此绘成的聚落地图显示，在科潘于公元500至850年间走向崩溃的过程中，城市周边农村人口的分布与密度发生了剧烈变化。
E
To find their sites, archaeologists today rely heavily on systematic survey methods and a variety of high-technology tools and techniques. Airborne technologies, such as different types of radar and photographic equipment carried by airplanes or spacecraft, allow archaeologists to learn about what lies beneath the ground without digging. Aerial surveys locate general areas of interest or larger buried features, such as ancient buildings or fields.
为找到遗址，今天的考古学家高度依赖系统的勘测方法和各种高技术工具与手段。机载技术——如飞机或航天器搭载的各类雷达与摄影设备——使考古学家无需挖掘便能了解地下埋藏。航空勘测可定位大致的感兴趣区域或更大的地下特征，如古代建筑或田地。
F
Most archaeological sites, however, are discovered by archaeologists who have set out to look for them. Such searches can take years. British archaeologist Howard Carter knew that the tomb of the Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun existed from information found in other sites. Carter sifted through rubble in the Valley of the Kings for seven years before he located the tomb in 1922. In the late 1800s British archaeologist Sir Arthur Evans combed antique dealers' stores in Athens, Greece. He was searching for engraved seals attributed to the ancient Mycenaean culture that dominated Greece from the 1400s to 1200s BC. Evans's interpretations of those engravings eventually led them to find the Minoan palace at Knossos on the island of Crete, in 1900.
然而，多数考古遗址是由特意前去寻找的考古学家发现的。这种搜寻可能历时数年。英国考古学家霍华德·卡特从其他遗址所获信息中得知埃及法老图坦卡蒙之墓存在。他在帝王谷的瓦砾中筛寻了七年，才于1922年定位该墓。19世纪末，英国考古学家阿瑟·埃文斯爵士在希腊雅典的古董商店铺中仔细搜寻，寻找据信属于公元前1400至1200年主导希腊的迈锡尼文明的刻印。埃文斯对这些刻印的解读，最终引导人们在1900年找到了克里特岛克诺索斯的米诺斯宫殿。
G
Ground surveys allow archaeologists to pinpoint the places where digs will be successful. Most ground surveys involve a lot of walking, looking for surface clues such as small fragments of pottery. They often include a certain amount of digging to test for buried materials at selected points across a landscape. Archaeologists also may locate buried remains by using such technologies as ground radar, magnetic-field recording, and metal detector. Archaeologists commonly use computers to map sites and the landscapes around sites. Two and three-dimensional maps are helpful tools in planning excavations, illustrating how sites look, and presenting the results of archaeological research.
地面勘测让考古学家能精准定位挖掘将有所收获的地点。多数地面勘测需要大量步行，寻找陶片之类的地表线索。它们通常还包括一定量的挖掘，以测试地貌上若干选点的地下埋藏。考古学家也可借助地面雷达、磁场记录与金属探测器等技术定位地下遗存。考古学家通常还用计算机为遗址及其周边地貌绘制地图。二维与三维地图是规划发掘、展示遗址样貌以及呈现考古研究成果的有用工具。
41
排序题
答案 C
匹配依据A段首句"Some archaeological sites have always been easily observable"——但A段是已知位置。41在A之前。C段首句"How do archaeologists know where to find...when there is nothing visible on the surface?"——这是个总起问句，引出全文话题，且 C 段讲"survey and sample"，自然过渡到 A 段讲"有些遗址显眼"。
42
排序题
答案 F
匹配依据A段末讲"many others discovered by accident（偶然发现）"。F段首句"Most archaeological sites, however, are discovered by archaeologists who have set out to look for them."——"however"转折，从偶然发现转到主动寻找（卡特找图坦卡蒙墓、伊文思找米诺斯宫殿），与A段形成对比。
43
排序题
答案 G
匹配依据E段讲"airborne technologies（机载雷达、航空摄影）"。G段首句"Ground surveys allow archaeologists to pinpoint the places..."——从空中调查（airborne）转到地面调查（ground surveys），逻辑顺承。
44
排序题
答案 D
匹配依据G段讲地面调查方法（walking, looking for pottery fragments, ground radar等）。D段首句"Surveys can cover a single large settlement or entire landscapes."——继续讲 surveys 的范围，并举例科潘（Copán）遗址。
45
排序题
答案 B
匹配依据D段讲 Copán 的 aerial photographs + on foot surveys。B段首句"In another case, American archaeologists...mapping the entire city of Teotihuacán"——"In another case"明显承接 D 段的 "In one case"，举另一个系统测绘的例子。
干扰项本文只有B、C、D、F、G五个可选段，全部使用，无干扰项。
Part C · 英译汉逐句翻译（46–50）
46
翻译
It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is articulate our reactions to it, and not grasp music itself.
这也解释了为什么当我们尝试用语言描述音乐的时候，充其量只能说清楚自己的感受，而无法抓住音乐本身。
采分点① the reason why ……的原因；② try to describe 试图描述；③ articulate our reactions to it 说清我们对它的感受；④ grasp music itself 抓住音乐本身。
47
翻译
By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find courage an essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works.
总而言之，他是一个思想不受束缚的人，而且是一个富有勇气的人。我认为勇气是理解——更是演奏——其作品不可或缺的品格。
采分点① By all accounts 总而言之/大家都说；② freethinking 思想自由的；③ find sth + 名词宾补 发现某物是……；④ let alone 更不用说。
48
翻译
Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him.
贝多芬惯以超凡的力度加大音响，随后突然进入一个意想不到的柔和乐段。这种手法在他之前的作曲家中极为罕见。
采分点① extreme intensity 极强的力度；② abruptly 突然地；③ soft passage 柔和的乐段；④ rarely 罕见地。
49
翻译
Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression.
尤具深意的是他的自由观，在他看来自由关系到个人的权利与责任：他主张思想自由和个人表达的自由。
采分点① 倒装句 Especially significant was... 尤具深意的是……；② be associated with 与……相关；③ advocate 主张。
50
翻译
One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but the courage to fight it renders life worth living.
苦难是不可避免的，但与之抗争的勇气正是生活的意义所在。对贝多芬的诸多作品，我们都可做此解读。
采分点① interpret 解读；② suffering is inevitable 苦难不可避免；③ render life worth living 使生活值得过。
Section III · Writing 写作
Part A 小作文（10分）— 建议信

原题指令 Directions

Suppose you are a student. Write a letter to the president of your university, suggesting how to improve students' physical fitness. You can include any details that you think necessary. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address.

【译文】假设你是一名学生。给校长写一封信，就如何增强学生体质提出建议。可包含你认为必要的细节。字数约100词。信末不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。不要写地址。

题目

给校长写一封约100词的信，就如何改善学生体质提出建议。可包含你认为必要的细节。落款 Li Ming，不写地址。

审题

① 格式：正式建议信（Dear Mr. President,）；② 语气：恭敬但具体；③ 内容：2-3条具体建议（增加体育设施、调整课程安排、举办运动会等）。

参考范文

Dear Mr. President,

I am a sophomore from the Department of Electronics. I am writing to offer several suggestions on how to improve students' physical fitness.

First, I suggest that the university expand the sports grounds and purchase more fitness equipment, so that students can work out conveniently after class. Second, it would help to make PE classes compulsory rather than optional, and to schedule them at varied times. Finally, holding regular sports meets and fun competitions, such as rope-skipping contests, could spark students' enthusiasm for exercise.

I hope you will find these proposals useful. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Yours sincerely, Li Ming

【译文】

尊敬的主席先生：

我是电子系大二学生。谨此就如何改善学生体质提出几点建议。

首先，建议学校扩建运动场地、增购健身器材，方便同学课后锻炼。其次，将体育课由选修改为必修，并错峰排课，会更有帮助。最后，定期举办运动会和跳绳赛等趣味比赛，能激发学生运动热情。

望您觉得这些建议有用。感谢您的时间与考量。

谨上，李明

Part B 大作文（20分）— 图画作文《相携》

原题指令 Directions

Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The two pictures show a young mother holding her little daughter's hand 30 years ago, and now the grown-up daughter supporting her aged mother. The title is "Mutual Support".

【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 左边：三十年前，一位年轻妈妈牵着小女孩的手；右边：如今长大成人的女儿搀扶着年迈的母亲。标题：相携。

图画描述

左边：三十年前，一位年轻妈妈牵着小女孩的手；右边：现在，长大成人的女儿搀扶着年迈的母亲。图画标题"相携"。

审题框架

三段式：①简要描述图画（母女角色互换、相互扶持）；②阐释含义（孝道、代际反哺、亲情传承）；③给出评论（应以身作则、营造孝老氛围）。160-200词。

参考范文

The drawing vividly depicts a touching scene of "mutual support." Thirty years ago, a young mother held her little daughter's hand; today, the grown-up daughter supports her aged mother. Together the two pictures convey a timeless virtue of Chinese families—filial piety and the passing of love between generations.

The implied meaning is thought-provoking. On the one hand, parents sacrifice their youth to nurture their children; on the other, when parents grow old, children have a duty to repay that devotion. This mutual care is the very foundation of a harmonious family. Regrettably, in modern society some young people take their parents' love for granted and even shift the burden of elder care onto society.

From my perspective, we should carry forward the tradition of filial piety. Parents should set an example by respecting their own elders, while society as a whole should encourage the young to care for the old. Only in this way can we build a warm and loving community.

【译文】

图画生动地描绘了一个"相携"的感人场景。三十年前，年轻的母亲牵着小女儿的手；如今，长大成人的女儿搀扶着年迈的母亲。两幅图共同传递着中国家庭永恒的美德——孝道与爱的代际传承。

其寓意发人深省。一方面，父母牺牲青春养育子女；另一方面，当父母年老，子女也有责任回报这份付出。这种相互关怀正是和谐家庭的基石。遗憾的是，现代社会中有些年轻人把父母的爱视为理所当然，甚至把养老的负担推给社会。

在我看来，我们应传承孝亲传统。父母应以身作则、敬重自己的长辈，社会也应整体倡导青年敬老爱老。唯其如此，我们才能建成一个温暖而有爱的大家庭。

Section I   Use of English · 完形填空逐句精读

Though not biologically related, friends are as "related" as fourth cousins, sharing about 1% of genes. That is 1 a study, published from the University of California and Yale University in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, has 2.

尽管朋友之间没有血缘关系，但他们的"亲缘"程度相当于第四代表亲，共享约1%的基因。这正是加州大学和耶鲁大学发表于《美国国家科学院院刊》的一项研究所得出的结论。

The study is a genome-wide analysis conducted 3 1,932 unique subjects which 4 pairs of unrelated friends and unrelated strangers. The same people were used in both 5.

这项研究对1932名独立受试者进行了全基因组分析，比较了成对的无血缘朋友和无血缘陌生人。同一批人同时被用于两组样本。

While 1% may seem 6, it is not so to a geneticist. As James Fowler, professor of medical genetics at UC San Diego, says, "Most people do not even 7 their fourth cousins but somehow manage to select as friends the people who 8 our kin."

尽管1%看起来可能微不足道，但对遗传学家而言并非如此。正如加州大学圣地亚哥分校医学遗传学教授詹姆斯·福勒所说："大多数人甚至不认识自己的第四代表亲，却莫名地选择了与我们亲属相似的人做朋友。"

The study 9 found that the genes for smell were something shared in friends but not genes for immunity. Why this similarity exists in smell genes is difficult to explain, for now. 10, as the team suggests, it draws us to similar environments but there is more 11 it. There could be many mechanisms working together that 12 us in choosing genetically similar friends 13 "functional kinship" of being friends with 14!

该研究还发现，朋友之间共享的是嗅觉基因，而非免疫基因。目前尚难以解释为什么这种相似性存在于嗅觉基因中。也许，正如研究团队所说，它吸引我们走向相似的环境，但事情还不止于此。可能有多种机制共同作用，驱使我们在选择基因相似的朋友时——而非"功能性亲属关系"——与能带来益处的人交朋友！

One of the remarkable findings of the study was that the similar genes seem to be evolving 15 than other genes. Studying this could help 16 why human evolution picked pace in the last 30,000 years, with social environment being a major 17 factor.

该研究的一个显著发现是，相似基因的演化速度似乎比其他基因更快。研究这一点有助于理解为什么人类进化在过去三万年中加快了步伐，其中社会环境是一个主要的促成因素。

The findings do not simply explain people's 18 to befriend those of similar 19 backgrounds, say the researchers. Though all the subjects were drawn from a population of European extraction, care was taken to 20 that all subjects, friends and strangers, were taken from the same population.

研究人员表示，这些发现并非简单地解释了人们倾向于与那些有相似族裔背景的人交朋友的现象。尽管所有受试者都来自欧洲血统的人群，但研究人员还是特意确保所有受试者——无论是朋友还是陌生人——都取自同一人群。

Reading Part A · Text 1 逐句精读

King Juan Carlos of Spain once insisted "kings don't abdicate, they die in their sleep." But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euro-elections have forced him to eat his words and stand down. So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days? Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?

西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯曾坚称："国王不会退位，他们会在睡梦中辞世。"但令人尴尬的丑闻以及近期欧洲议会选举中共和左派的声望，迫使他食言并退位。那么，西班牙危机是否意味着君主制正走向末日？是否意味着所有那些身着华服、生活奢华的欧洲王室都面临灭顶之灾？

The Spanish case provides arguments both for and against monarchy. When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above "mere" politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.

西班牙事件为支持和反对君主制都提供了论据。当公众舆论严重两极分化时——如佛朗哥政权结束后那样——君主可以超越"纯粹的"政治，"体现"国家统一的精神。

It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state. And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarch-infested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican City and Andorra). But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.

正是这种明显的政治超越性，解释了君主作为国家元首持续受欢迎的原因。因此，除中东外，欧洲是世界上君主最多的地区，有10个王国（不包括梵蒂冈和安道尔）。但与海湾地区和亚洲的专制君主不同，大多数王室之所以存续，是因为他们让选民不必费力去寻找一个没有争议又受人尊敬的公众人物。

Even so, kings and queens undoubtedly have a downside. Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history—and sometimes the way they behave today—embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities. At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.

即便如此，国王和王后们无疑也有不利的一面。尽管他们声称是国家统一的象征，但他们的历史——有时还有他们今天的行为方式——体现了过时且站不住脚的特权与不平等。在托马斯·皮凯蒂等经济学家警告不平等加剧、继承财富日益强大的时代，富裕的贵族家庭竟然仍是现代民主国家的象征性核心，这实在荒谬。

The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways. Princes and princesses have day-jobs and ride bicycles, not horses (or helicopters). Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.

最成功的王室努力抛弃或隐藏旧的贵族做派。王子公主们有日常工作，骑自行车，而不是骑马（或直升机）。即便如此，这些都是与国际1%富豪一起聚会的富裕家庭，媒体的侵扰使他们越来越难维持良好形象。

While Europe's monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come, it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example.

尽管欧洲王室无疑足够聪明，能在未来一段时间继续存续，但最应该从西班牙事件中感到恐惧的，是英国王室。

It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy's reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style. The danger will come with Charles, who has both an expensive taste of lifestyle and a pretty hierarchical view of the world. He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service—as non-controversial and non-political heads of state. Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy's worst enemies.

唯有女王以她相当普通（尽管富裕）的老奶奶风格保住了君主制的声誉。危险将随查尔斯而来——他既有奢华的生活品味，又有相当等级化的世界观。他未能理解，君主制之所以存续，很大程度上是因为他们提供了一种服务——作为无争议、非政治的国家元首。查尔斯应该知道，正如英国历史所示，国王才是君主制最大的敌人，而非共和主义者。

21

Text 2   智能手机隐私与第四修正案（26–30）

Just how much does the Constitution protect your digital data? The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.

宪法究竟在多大程度上保护你的数字数据？最高法院将审议：警察在逮捕时，若手机在嫌疑人身上或附近，能否在没有搜查令的情况下查看手机内容。

California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling, particularly one that upsets the old assumption that authorities may search through the possessions of suspects at the time of their arrest. It is hard, the state argues, for judges to assess the implications of new and rapidly changing technologies.

加州已请求大法官们避免做出一刀切的裁决，尤其是那种打破"当局可在逮捕时搜查嫌疑人财物"这一旧假设的裁决。该州认为，法官很难评估快速变化的新技术所带来的影响。

The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California's advice. Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police, lawyers and defendants.

如果最高法院听从加州的建议，那将是不负责任的保守。其影响已经足够清晰，甚至显而易见，大法官们能够也应该向警察、律师和被告提供更新后的指导方针。

They should start by discarding California's lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone—a vast storehouse of digital information—is similar to, say, going through a suspect's purse. The court has ruled that police don't violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant. But exploring one's smartphone is more like entering his or her home. A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence. The development of "cloud computing," meanwhile, has made that exploration so much the easier.

他们首先应该摒弃加州那个站不住脚的论点——即查看智能手机（一个庞大的数字信息库）内容类似于翻查嫌疑人的钱包。最高法院曾裁定，警察在没有搜查令的情况下翻看被捕者的钱包不算违反第四修正案。但查看智能手机更像是进入一个人的家。一部智能手机可能包含被捕者的阅读史、财务史、医疗史以及近期通信的完整记录。与此同时，"云计算"的发展使这种查看变得更加容易。

Americans should take steps to protect their digital privacy. But keeping sensitive information on these devices is increasingly a requirement of normal life. Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution's prohibition on unreasonable searches.

美国人应该采取措施保护他们的数字隐私。但在这些设备上保存敏感信息日益成为正常生活的需要。公民仍然有权期待私人文件保持私密，并受宪法禁止无理搜查条款的保护。

As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing. In many cases, it would not be overly burdensome for authorities to obtain a warrant to search through phone contents. They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant. The court, though, may want to allow room for police to cite situations where they are entitled to more freedom.

但正如常见的那样，阐明这一原则并不能减轻划定界限的挑战。在许多情况下，当局申请搜查令来查看手机内容并非过于繁重。在面临严重紧急情况时，他们仍可以不受第四修正案保护的约束，并且可以采取合理措施确保在等待搜查令期间手机数据不被删除或篡改。不过，最高法院也许想给警察留出空间，让他们能援引那些有权获得更多自由的情形。

But the justices should not swallow California's argument whole. New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections. Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.

但大法官们不应全盘接受加州的论点。具有颠覆性的新技术有时要求对宪法保护条款做出新的应用。法学教授奥林·克尔将21世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长和可及性，与20世纪汽车成为生活必需品相提并论：当时大法官们不得不为乘用车这一新的私人领域制定新规则；现在他们必须理清第四修正案如何适用于数字信息。

Text 3  《科学》杂志加强统计审查（31–35）

The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today. The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.

《科学》杂志主编玛西娅·麦克纳特今日宣布，该杂志将在同行评审流程中增加一轮额外的统计审查。此前，由于人们普遍担忧数据分析中的基础错误正导致许多已发表的研究成果无法重复，其他期刊也已做出类似努力。

"Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal," writes McNutt in an editorial. Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE). Manuscript will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers. The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.

"读者必须对我们杂志发表的结论有信心，"麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道。该杂志与美国统计协会合作，已任命七位专家组成统计评审编辑委员会（SBoRE）。论文将被标记出来，由杂志内部编辑、现有评审编辑委员会或外部同行评审者进行额外审查。SBoRE小组随后将寻找外部统计学家来评审这些稿件。

Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish."

当被问及是否有特定论文推动了这一变革时，麦克纳特说："'统计委员会'的设立，是出于对统计学和数据分析在科研中应用的广泛担忧，也是《科学》杂志提高所发表研究可重复性这一整体努力的一部分。"

Giovanni Parmigiani, a biostatistician at the Harvard School of Public Health, a member of the SBoRE group, says he expects the board to "play primarily an advisory role." He agreed to join because he "found the foresight behind the establishment of the SBoRE to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact. This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but hopefully through a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science."

哈佛公共卫生学院生物统计学家、SBoRE成员乔瓦尼·帕尔米贾尼说，他预计该委员会"主要扮演咨询角色"。他同意加入是因为他"发现成立SBoRE背后的远见新颖、独特，且可能产生持久影响。这种影响不仅会通过《科学》本身的出版物体现，还有望通过更多想要效仿《科学》做法的出版机构体现。"

John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is "a most welcome step forward" and "long overdue." "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish. I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says. But he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.

研究研究方法论的医生约翰·约阿尼迪斯表示，这一政策是"备受欢迎的一步"，而且"早该如此"。"大多数期刊在统计审查方面很薄弱，这损害了它们所发表内容的质量。我认为，对于当今大多数科学论文而言，统计审查比专家审查更为重要，"他说。但他也指出，《内科学年鉴》《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊对统计审查高度重视。

Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyze data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist. Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, "engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process." Vaux says that Science's idea to pass some papers to statisticians "has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify 'the papers that need scrutiny' in the first place."

细胞生物学家大卫·沃克斯表示，专业科学家理应知道如何分析数据，但已发表研究中统计错误之常见令人担忧。他在2012年写道，研究人员应该提高自己的标准，但期刊也应采取更强硬的立场，"聘用懂统计的评审者和能核实流程的编辑"。沃克斯说，《科学》将部分论文交给统计学家的想法"有一定价值，但弱点在于它首先依赖评审编辑委员会来识别'哪些论文需要审查'。"

31
细节题
答案 B
It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that ___.从第1款中可以了解到___。
[A] Science intends to simplify its peer-review process.科学界意在简化其同行评审流程。
[B] journals are strengthening their statistical checks.
[C] few journals are blamed for mistakes in data analysis.很少有期刊因数据分析错误而受责。
[D] lack of data analysis is common in research projects.缺乏数据分析在研究项目中很常见。
💡 考场思路首段：adding an extra round of statistical checks + similar efforts from other journals——期刊正在加强统计审查。
逐项分析 [A] 简化同行评审 → 与 extra round 相反；
[B] 期刊加强统计审查 → 正确；
[C] 很少期刊被指责 → 与 widespread concern 相反；
[D] 缺乏数据分析 → 原文是 mistakes in data analysis，不是 lack。
核心词汇
peer-review n. 同行评审
irreproducibility n. 不可重复性
manuscript n. 稿件
scrutiny n. 审查
overdue adj. 早该发生的
methodology n. 方法论
32
词义题

Text 4   新闻诚信缺失与电话窃听案（36–40）

Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch's daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the "unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions." Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market. But "it's us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit."

两年前，鲁伯特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白谈到"我们众多机构中诚信令人不安地缺失"。她认为，诚信已经崩塌，因为人们普遍接受社会唯一的"分选机制"应该是利润和市场。但"创造我们想要的社会的，是我们人类自己，而不是利润。"

Driving her point home, she continued: "It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom." This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.

为进一步阐明观点，她继续说道："政府、媒体或商界内部缺乏道德目标和道德语言，这一点日益明显，可能成为资本主义和自由最危险的目标之一。"她认为，同样的道德目标缺失正在损害新闻国际等公司，使其更可能像在大规模非法电话窃听事件中那样迷失方向。

As the hacking trial concludes—finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge—the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands. Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people. This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking. Others await trial. This long story still unfolds.

随着窃听审判的结束——《世界新闻报》前编辑安迪·库尔森因合谋窃听电话被判有罪，而其前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯在同一指控中被判无罪——更广泛的诚信缺失问题依然存在。已知记者窃听了多达5500人的电话。这是工业规模的窃听，正如格伦·穆尔凯尔所承认的那样，他是《世界新闻报》2001年聘用的电话窃听负责人。其他人还在等待审判。这一漫长的故事仍在展开。

In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place. One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived. The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.

在许多方面，道德目标的缺失不仅构成了这种大规模电话窃听的事实，也构成了审判进行的条件。令人震惊的揭露之一是，丽贝卡·布鲁克斯对其编辑部发生的事情知之甚少，她几乎没想过问，也从未询问新闻是如何得来的。她成功辩护的核心就是她一无所知。

In today's world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organisations that they run. Perhaps we should not be so surprised. For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit. The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation. Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.

在当今世界，高薪高管不对自己所运营组织中发生的事情负责，这已成为常态。也许我们不该如此惊讶。对于一代人来说，集体信条一直是社会的分选机制应该是利润。重要的词汇是效率、灵活性、股东价值、有利商业、财富创造、销售额、影响力，以及在报业中的发行量。被边缘化的词汇则是正义、公平、宽容、相称和问责。

The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity. It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact. Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions—nor received traceable, recorded answers.

《世界新闻报》的编辑目的不是增进读者理解、公正报道或流露任何共同人性。它的目的是在追求发行量和影响力的过程中毁掉人们的生活。布鲁克斯女士可能怀疑、也可能不怀疑她的记者是如何得到新闻的，但她没有问任何问题，没有给出任何指示——也没有收到可追溯、有记录的回答。

36
细节题
答案 A
According to the first two paragraphs, Elisabeth was upset by ___.根据前两段，伊丽莎白对___感到不安。
[A] the consequences of the current sorting mechanism.
